gap.heading: Why it exists
gap.sub: India's pincode covers 60,000 to 70,000 residents per code, grouping together neighbourhoods with entirely different characteristics. Location Intelligence replaces pincode-level approximation with 100-metre precision, built for how Indian addresses actually work: incomplete entries, mixed languages, landmark-based descriptions, and village-taluka-district hierarchies.
hero.heading: Every Indian address, parsed, placed, and profiled — up to 100-metre resolution.
hero.sub: An API that takes any Indian address, in any format, and returns a structured location profile at 100-metre grid resolution: parsed, geocoded, enriched, triangulated, and velocity-assessed. No additional integration required.
